finding.title: A waiting backup is skipped
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a scheduler that skips a due backup while the previous one runs, because `makes the next one wait until it finishes` (S:6), and the Sunday full backup is lost.

e1.text: makes the next one wait until it finishes
e1.context:
## 1. Schedule
R1. A full backup runs every Sunday at 01:00 UTC.
R2. An incremental backup runs every other day at 01:00 UTC.
R3. A backup job that is still running when the next one is due makes the next one wait until it finishes.

## 2. Storage
R4. Backups are written to the primary storage bucket.
